viewing_check: Pick up several cards and read the stamps on the backs/posts: 9ct, 375, 'GP', 'RGP', 'sterling', 925. Check the card printing for a stated metal and carat. Weigh a few pairs. If most are 375, tally the pairs and weigh; if plated or CZ costume, value is low. Also check the tennis bracelet's clasp for a 925 or 375 stamp and whether stones are CZ.
